meta_description:
67K likes, 949 comments - ladygaga on October 5, 2026: "Warm tones for cool people. Introducing the new @hauslabs Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil. 11 Shades are available now at HausLabs.com and @Sephora.

Cool is using your voice for something bigger than yourself.

@nyariangchieng is a mental health advocate who believes beauty begins within, and she uses her voice for the causes she cares about, from wellness to social justice. Her playful, positive energy is impossible to miss.
 Nyariang wears Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil in Mirage.

Warm tones for cool people. 

Available now at: hauslabs.com @sephora online + in stores @sephoracanada online + in stores

Cool is showing up for people. 

@jeyafrobaess does it all as an R&B and reggae artist, songwriter, and producer, and as an executive member of @sharinghopemedicalusa, a nonprofit running surgical missions in underserved communities.

Jey wears Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil in Oasis.

Warm tones for cool people. 

Cool is co-founding a company.

@a_ishaadebayo is VP of Operations and co-founder of Beauty In Color, which celebrates women through faith and culture. History, international studies, nursing: she’s endlessly curious about the stories that shape the world.

Aisha wears Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil in Mahogany.

Warm tones for cool people. 

Cool is hearing “no” and following your dream anyway.

@theacaciamcbride is Miss California USA 2026 and co-founder of @micahswalkforautism, a nonprofit inspired by her younger brother, Micah, that supports people with autism and developmental disabilities and their families.

Acacia wears Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil in Suede.

Warm tones for cool people. 

Cool is turning your own health journey into something that helps others.

@ryleesellerrs shares what she’s learned through her journey with hormones and wellness, and she hopes to study Traditional Chinese Medicine or holistic health. So yes, what goes on her skin matters.

Rylee wears Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil in Sand.

Warm tones for cool people.

Cool is a science brain with a makeup brush. 
	
@emma.kaitalin studied nursing, has always been fascinated by science, and uses makeup as her favorite creative outlet. Lifelong animal lover, too.

Emma wears Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil in Sand".
